company.description: The Wealth Karma is a Dubai-based fintech and financial wellness platform focused on helping expats in the GCC region improve financial literacy, retirement planning, and long-term wealth management. The platform provides personalized financial education through bite-sized learning modules, assessments, digital tools, and access to financial advisors.
